reuse.why: Fintegra shares linking and download helpers with existing providers, but its takeover cleanup copies the local cleanup inside unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The change removes substantial provider duplication but duplicates unlink field clearing and repeats the replaced-account clearing loop in saveLinkedAccount.

placement.why: Link orchestration, transaction downloading, server configuration and provider types remain in their established layers.

scope.why: The edits support the four requested changes, with only necessary client provider-map updates and release notes.

maintainability.why: Shared validation and provider adapters make future changes straightforward, but unlink cleanup should have one definition and the expanded assertion helper deserves a broader name.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts: clearAccountLink separately implements unlinkAccount's local cleanup instead of extracting a common operation used by both paths.

disguised_duplication.where: accounts/app.ts: clearAccountLink presents unlink cleanup as a shared helper, while unlinkAccount retains the same field-clearing implementation.

abstraction_drift.where: accounts/app.ts: replacement adds replaceExistingLink to assertBankAccountNotLinked and replacedIds to saveLinkedAccount; validation gains upgradingId and closed-target branches, while unlinkAccount retains cleanup outside clearAccountLink.
